description: Orchestrates primary, secondary, and quaternary preventive medicine, screening optimization, multi-morbidity risk stratification, biological age modeling, and immunization kinetics.

inputs.name: profile
inputs.description: Demographic, clinical baseline, and pedigree data.

inputs.name: biomarkers
inputs.description: Routine clinical laboratory chemistry, hematology, and metabolic parameters.

inputs.name: screening_history
inputs.description: Historical screening exams, intervals, and biopsy findings.

inputs.name: vaccination_ledger
inputs.description: Longitudinal immunization and antigen exposure records.

inputs.name: lifestyle_metrics
inputs.description: Cardiorespiratory fitness, sleep architecture, and dietary pattern indices.

outputs.name: risk_stratification
outputs.description: ASCVD 10-year risk score, CKM stage, and multi-cancer risk assessment.

outputs.name: biological_age
outputs.description: PhenoAge computation, chronological age delta, and physiological aging velocity.

outputs.name: screening_schedule
outputs.description: USPSTF/guideline-aligned screening directives with individualized intervals.

outputs.name: immunization_audit
outputs.description: Vaccination gaps, booster alerts, and contraindication verifications.

outputs.name: quaternary_alerts
outputs.description: Warnings against low-value testing, overdiagnosis cascades, and overtreatment.

outputs.name: prevention_plan
outputs.description: Integrated personalized roadmap for primary, secondary, and quaternary healthspan optimization.
